short_description: Design team hitting seat limit on Adobe Creative Cloud
description: New designer cannot activate Adobe apps -- team has hit its license seat limit.
resolution: Reclaimed an unused seat from a departed employee's account and reassigned it.

short_description: New laptop won't detect any USB peripherals
description: User's new laptop doesn't recognize mouse, keyboard dock, or external drive via USB-C hub.
resolution: USB-C hub firmware was outdated; updated firmware resolved detection.

short_description: Cannot open shared support mailbox in Outlook
description: User gets 'Cannot expand the folder' error opening the shared support@company.com mailbox.
resolution: Shared mailbox permissions hadn't propagated; re-applied Full Access permissions.

short_description: Nightly backup job failing for the last 3 days
description: The automated nightly database backup has failed silently for three consecutive nights.

short_description: Namespace resource quota exceeded, new pods pending
description: New deployments to the analytics namespace are stuck Pending because the CPU quota is exhausted.

short_description: Password expired, cannot log into laptop remotely
description: User's Windows password expired over the weekend; cannot reset remotely without VPN access first.

short_description: Locked out after 5 failed login attempts
description: User's account locked after mistyping password multiple times this morning.
resolution: Verified identity via security questions, unlocked account, issued temporary password.

short_description: Mailbox over quota, cannot send or receive
description: User's mailbox hit its storage quota and is rejecting new mail.
resolution: Archived mail older than 1 year to a PST; quota freed up.

short_description: Emails to external domain bouncing as spam
description: User's emails to a specific partner company are being rejected as spam by the recipient's server.

short_description: Laptop battery draining fully within an hour
description: User's 1-year-old laptop battery no longer holds a charge beyond ~50 minutes.
resolution: Battery health test confirmed degradation below 60% capacity; replacement ordered.

short_description: Contractor needs temporary limited-scope access
description: External contractor needs read-only access to one SharePoint site for a 90-day engagement.
resolution: Created a scoped guest account with a 90-day expiry.

short_description: Node running out of disk space, pods evicted
description: A worker node hit disk pressure and Kubernetes began evicting pods to reclaim space.
resolution: Cleared unused container images and increased the node's disk allocation.

short_description: Badge no longer opens 4th floor secure lab
description: Employee's access badge stopped working on the 4th floor secure lab door after a recent role change.
resolution: Access group had been removed during the role change; re-added the correct access group.

short_description: Departed employee's account still shows as active
description: Quarterly access review found a former employee's account was not disabled on their last day.
resolution: Disabled the account immediately and opened a process review for the offboarding checklist.

short_description: Laptop screen flickering intermittently
description: Screen flickers randomly, worse when the laptop is plugged into external power.

short_description: S3 bucket access denied for reporting service
description: The reporting service started getting AccessDenied errors reading from its S3 bucket after an IAM policy update.
resolution: Corrected an overly restrictive IAM policy condition that was added during a security hardening pass.

short_description: Cannot establish VPN connection from home network
description: User's home ISP appears to block the VPN port; connection attempt times out immediately.
resolution: Switched VPN client to TLS-based port 443 fallback; connectivity restored.

short_description: Finance floor shared printer offline for everyone
description: Printer HP-FIN-03 shows offline status; whole floor cannot print.
resolution: Printer lost its DHCP-reserved IP after a switch reboot; reassigned and restarted spooler.

short_description: CRM freezes when opening large customer records
description: Sales reps report the CRM UI freezes for 30+ seconds opening any account with 500+ activity records.

short_description: Slow file transfer speeds over VPN for remote team
description: Multiple remote sales team members report large file uploads take 10x longer than expected.

short_description: Finance reporting tool crashes on month-end close
description: The monthly close report generator crashes with an out-of-memory error every month-end, blocking close.
resolution: Increased the app server's memory allocation and optimized the report query; verified on next close cycle.

short_description: Possible credential compromise after phishing click
description: User clicked a link in a phishing email and entered their password on the fake login page before realizing.
resolution: Force-reset the user's password, revoked all active sessions, and reviewed account activity for anomalies -- no unauthorized access found.

short_description: Camera not detected in Teams meetings
description: User's laptop camera works in other apps but Teams shows 'no camera found'.
resolution: Teams had cached an old camera driver reference; cleared cache and camera was detected.

short_description: Cannot see corporate WiFi SSID on new laptop
description: New laptop doesn't list the corporate SSID in available networks.
resolution: WiFi adapter driver was outdated; updated driver and SSID appeared.

short_description: Pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff after deployment
description: The checkout-service pod enters CrashLoopBackOff immediately after the latest deployment.
resolution: Rolled back to the previous image version; root cause was a missing environment variable in the new config.

short_description: MFA app not generating codes after phone replacement
description: User got a new phone and the authenticator app no longer has their MFA seed.
resolution: Re-enrolled user's MFA on the new device after identity verification.

short_description: New hire starting Monday needs full account provisioning
description: New employee needs AD account, mailbox, VPN access, and standard software before their start date.
resolution: Provisioned from onboarding template; confirmed access with hiring manager.

short_description: Order processing database queries running 10x slower
description: Since this morning, order lookups that normally take 200ms are taking 2+ seconds, causing checkout delays.
resolution: Identified a missing index on the orders table after a schema migration; added the index, latency returned to normal.

short_description: VPN drops every few minutes on Cisco AnyConnect
description: User reports the VPN tunnel disconnects repeatedly during work hours, requiring manual reconnection each time.
resolution: MTU mismatch causing packet fragmentation; lowered client MTU to 1400 and enabled TCP MSS clamping.

short_description: Conference room WiFi keeps disconnecting
description: Guests in the 3rd floor conference room report repeated WiFi drops during video calls.
resolution: Replaced a failing access point; signal now stable.

short_description: Employee reported a suspicious invoice email
description: User forwarded a suspicious email claiming to be an overdue invoice with a link to 'verify payment'.
resolution: Confirmed phishing, blocked sender domain, and sent a company-wide advisory.
